currentWork.title: Field maintenance — sales overlap guard + explicit visit closeout
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.17 candidate is preview-verified on the maintenance branch. Confirmed sales periods are checked against prior confirmed sales for the same maker/vendor before OCR draft creation and again before confirmation; overlapping/cumulative periods fail closed. OCR reports now share an Analytics visit across follow-up captures, and explicit no-input/no-recovery resolutions support legitimate sales-only and no-recovery visits without inventing zero reports. The new visit/overlap browser gate and the existing OCR field regression gate both pass on the READY Vercel preview. Production merge/live verification is still pending.
scope: After a confirmed OCR report, offer an explicit next-step choice to continue capturing related paper or finish the visit.
Represent no input and/or no recovery as explicit visit resolutions, not fabricated report rows or inferred zero quantities.
Block overlapping confirmed sales periods for the same maker/vendor before OCR draft creation and re-check at report confirmation.
Allow adjacent non-overlapping sales periods; use a small five-minute tolerance only for boundary/clock noise.
Preserve explicit report confirmation and explicit machine linkage; do not auto-confirm or auto-link.
Keep Analytics DB/schema at 4 and leave production numeric forecasting behavior unchanged.
nextActions: Open and merge the bounded maintenance PR after reviewing diff scope and checks.
Verify the matching production Vercel deployment, GitHub Pages FINAL.17 version, and live regression gates.
Close the maintenance cycle and return to operational evidence accumulation.
Continue requiring real held-out evidence before any learned numeric promotion.
